en: I'm a pastor.
Say I tell myself: forget what others think,

text:
내가 내 스스로
내 *자아*를 가질 수 있다고
en: I can make my own self,
however hard I believe it,
if people say "I hate his sermons,"
curse me and flood the comments,
is anyone still happy?
No one.
That kind of self can't exist.

text:
개인이 아무리 생각해도
그런 자아는 존재하지 않고
en: However we think about it, it doesn't exist.
We all need someone's approval.
And what happens to human approval?
It always runs out.
Lean on it, and you'll fall.
In the end, the question of identity
isn't "Who am I?"
but "Whose am I?"
I want to serve faithfully,

text:
나는 지금 죽어서 천국을 가면
하나님의 완전한 *인정*이
en: and I know that in heaven God's full approval
is waiting for me.

text:
네가 다른 사람보다
더 열심히 했기 때문에
en: Not because I worked harder than others.
"Well done, good and faithful servant."
That approval is already there.

text:
나는 인정을 받기 위해서
일하지 않습니다
en: I don't work to be approved.
I work because I already am.
